text: Episode six. Announcements. When the venue changes on a Thursday night, you need to tell everyone who's coming — once, and only the people it concerns.
Write it once. A title, a couple of lines, and then who it's for: everyone coming to this event, all your members, one membership tier, or just the staff. Here it's the people who said yes to Friday.
Send it now, or schedule it — for the morning of, or an hour before doors. Once it's out, the sent list tells you exactly how many people it reached. Six, here. Nobody who didn't need it.
For the people coming, it lands in their notifications — and in their email inbox, if they've kept that on. And it stays on the event page, so anyone who signs up later still finds the new room.
One message, the right people, and no group chat to scroll through. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
